title: Event/Folder Join Reconciliation
summary: Reproduced Phase 0b's 17,203/6,065 eligibility split exactly, then classified every non-joinable event and every on-disk folder into exactly one failure/match class in both directions. Hit and resolved a T1 hard stop (526 unparseable folder names, three unrelated causes). Surfaced a major, previously-unknown data-quality fact along the way: momentum_events.date is null for 25.4% of rows.

escalations_triggered.resolution: Cooper-directed 3-part fix (ticker parser, stray-file exclusion, None-date deferral)

decisions_log.decision: Ticker parser extended to accept '.' and lowercase letters, applied only in T1's classifier, not in T2a's reproduction
decisions_log.reason: T2a must reproduce Phase 0b's original direct-string-construction logic exactly, which never used regex at all - the parser fix only affects how T1 labels pre-existing folders, not what's on disk

decisions_log.decision: 3 stray non-folder files excluded from the classified denominator, listed separately in the summary rather than silently dropped
decisions_log.reason: Cooper's instruction; keeps the sum-check auditable

decisions_log.decision: None-date folders looked up by (ticker, momentum_pct) instead of (ticker, date), since date is unusable
decisions_log.reason: Cooper's instruction; the only other usable join key the folder name provides

decisions_log.decision: None-date folders excluded from T2b's per-event (ticker,date) lookup index, so null-date events classify as folder_absent rather than being matched against an empty placeholder
decisions_log.reason: T2b has no 'matched' class - the precision concern in Cooper's instruction (don't silently land in matched) is a T2c concept; documented as a judgment call, not silently made

decisions_log.decision: T2b/T2c priority-ordered classification implemented as literal first-match-wins chains per the phase prompt's exact ordering
decisions_log.reason: duplicate_collision structurally unreachable under this ordering when format_mismatch is checked first - observed 0, consistent with the escalation table's implicit expectation

surprises: momentum_events.date is NULL for 5,911 of 23,268 rows (25.4%) - not previously known; discovered via the None-date folder lookup, not searched for directly.
folder_absent (5,911) exactly equals the momentum_events null-date count - not asserted as causal, but the exact match is itself informative.

orphan (folders with no matching event row) is 7,252 - notably larger than the ~932 implied by Schema.md's orientation-only reference counts (24,200 trades files vs 23,268 events); that reference was explicitly marked not-ground-truth and this confirms why.

Two files appeared in docs/ (Agent_Prompt_Standard (1).md confirming a real v1.2, and Mom-DB-Strategy-Research-Program.md) with mtimes predating this phase - not found in Phase 0b's exhaustive searches; not explained, not acted on (outside this phase's write scope), flagged for Cooper.
v1.2 of the prompt standard still does not define a Verification Block or Digest Contract section - the Phase 0b gap is not resolved by its appearance.
